_comment: Registry for QuickBooks Online. Connection facts, the Make scenarios that currently hold the only working QBO read path, and the known defects in them. Consumed by scripts/bookkeeper_pull.py, .claude/agents/bookkeeper-ingest-agent.md and (from Phase 5) .claude/agents/qbo-actions-agent.md. Method: methods/finance-reconciliation.md.
_correction_2026_09_11: The repo previously recorded that the bookkeeper source 'has never worked'. THAT IS WRONG and has been corrected in departments.json. The QBO read path DID work: Make scenario 4822446 pulled 102 real chart-of-accounts records and 4822687 pulled two full P&L reports, on 2026-07-11 and 2026-07-12. The artifacts are still in Make data stores 88653 and 88661. What is true is narrower and more fixable: the ingest AGENT has no access path (no MCP server, no script), and every Make bookkeeper scenario is on-demand with no trigger, so nothing has re-run in about two months.

company._fiscal_note: QBO carries its own fiscal-year setting. Confirm it is set to September 30 in QBO so its 'this fiscal year to date' P&L agrees with finance/periods/*.json. Two disagreeing YTD figures is the failure this pipeline exists to prevent.

access._comment: There is NO direct QBO API client in this repo and NO Intuit MCP server in .mcp.json. The only working path today is through Make, using the connection below.
access._token_warning: OAuth token expires 2026-11-01. Refresh before then or every scenario below stops silently.

duplicate_connections.4820019: Same app and realm, valid to 2026-10-20, ZERO scenario usages. Duplicate.
duplicate_connections.3803761: QuickBooks (Legacy) app, no expiry, ZERO usages. Stale.

access._direct_api_note: A direct read-only client (scripts/qbo_client.py, mirroring scripts/lightspeed_client.py) is the eventual target: no per-operation metering, and the no-write-verb guarantee becomes structural and testable. It needs an Intuit app plus OAuth refresh handling, and no QBO credentials are present in the environment today. Decide deliberately; do not half-build both.

make_scenarios._comment: Organization 1154376 (Titan Flooring Inc.), team 459654, folder 323841 'Titan Bookkeeper'. Make log retention is 30 days, so July execution records have expired — the data stores are the evidence these ran.
make_scenarios._all_parked: All five are isActive: true but scheduled on-demand with nextExec: null and hookId: null. They will NEVER fire on their own. Functionally parked.

4822446.does: quickbooks:SearchForAccounts 'select * from account maxresults 1000' -> data store 88653, keyed on QBO account id, overwrite true.
4822446.proven: 102 records in store 88653 (32,229 bytes) with real balances.

4822687.name: Pull P&L Report
4822687.does: GET /reports/ProfitAndLoss -> JSON -> six 12,000-char slices into data store 88661 as pl_1..pl_6.
4822687.proven: Two full reports stored, Header.Time 2026-07-11T04:41 and 2026-07-12T19:53.
4822687.defect: DATE RANGE IS HARDCODED to start_date=2026-01-01 / end_date=2026-07-13. It can only ever re-fetch that window. Parameterize before any scheduled use.
4822687.status: works but cannot produce a current P&L

4824058.name: Create New CoA Accounts (one-time)
4824058.does: GetAccount on hardcoded id 173 -> one summary string into store 88661 under key acct173.
4824058.defect: MISNAMED — it creates nothing. It is a single-account probe.

4824368.name: Register Closure Watchdog
4824368.does: Counts QBO Invoices, and if zero sends WhatsApp and creates a high-priority 'Close Lightspeed register' Notion task.
4824368.defect: CRITICAL — the query filters MetaData.CreateTime > '2027-01-01', a FUTURE date. totalCount is therefore always 0, the filter always passes, and the alarm always fires. Scheduling it as-is would send a WhatsApp message and create a duplicate Notion task on every single run. The literal was meant to be a rolling window and was never made dynamic.
4824368.also: It never touches Lightspeed. It infers register closure indirectly by counting QBO invoices — which cannot distinguish 'register not closed' from 'sync not working'.
4824368.status: DO NOT SCHEDULE until the date literal is fixed

4841468.name: Outlook INVOICE -> QBO Receipts
4841468.does: Lists info@titanfloors.ca messages with attachments received >= 2025-10-01, forwards to titanflooring@qbodocs.com, then moves to a 'Sent to QBO' subfolder.
4841468.defect: Unproven — no durable artifact shows it ever ran. limit 100 over a backdated filter with NO dedupe store; the move-to-folder step is the only dedupe and it runs LAST, so a mid-run failure leaves duplicates in QBO.
4841468.status: highest-risk to run blind; never touches the QBO API

88661.name: QBO Reports
88661._note: Doing double duty: P&L chunks plus the acct173 probe. pl_2..pl_6 and py_2..py_6 are empty strings because each report fits inside the first 12,000-char slice.

observed_pl._comment: Pulled from data store 88661 on 2026-09-11; the report itself was generated 2026-07-12. Recorded here because it is the strongest available evidence for the Lightspeed->QBO gap, and because it must NOT be quoted as current.
observed_pl._stale: Covers Jan 1 - Jul 13 2026 only. Do not present as a current figure.
observed_pl._finding: CORRECTED 2026-09-11, replacing 'sales are substantially not posting'. Compared against Lightspeed over IDENTICAL periods, REVENUE RECONCILES: 2025 is 0.3% apart on $1.23M. The problem is COGS, and it misses in BOTH DIRECTIONS — QBO COGS is $279,286 BELOW Lightspeed's cost-of-goods-sold in 2025 and $217,103 ABOVE it in 2026 YTD. A figure that swings that way year over year is not a sync gap. It is the signature of COGS booked on a PURCHASE basis rather than a COST-OF-SALE basis: buy less than you sell and margin looks excellent (2025 showed 52%), buy more and you post a loss (2026 YTD shows -4.3%). Inventory Asset stands at $358,721.66. Lightspeed's own margin is stable and plausible every month — 19-30% through 2026, 29.0% for 2025 — and THAT is the real gross margin. The -$185,697 'loss' is an inventory-accounting artifact, not a business result, and no decision should rest on it. NOT CONFIRMED with the bookkeeper: whether purchases are expensed straight to COGS is a question for Albert and Prophecy Bookkeeping, not something this pipeline should infer.
observed_pl._units: Integer cents CAD, per CLAUDE.md conventions.
observed_pl._gap_c_sized: QBO income EXCEEDS Lightspeed revenue by $74,907 in 2026 YTD while matching within 0.3% in 2025. The project business formalised in 2026 (Notion Project Financials starts 2026-03-28). The likeliest reading is project revenue invoiced directly in QuickBooks, never rung through Lightspeed — exactly the Gap C behaviour Albert described, now with a number on it.
observed_pl._margin_compression: Lightspeed gross margin fell from 29.0% (2025) to 22.8% (2026 YTD). That is real compression in the trustworthy number, and it has been invisible under a P&L reporting 52% then -4%.

accounts._comment: QBO account ids the reconciler needs. RESOLVED 2026-09-11 from Make data store 88653 (102 accounts, live balances as at the 2026-07 pull). Balances are recorded for context only — they are a July snapshot and must never be quoted as current.

accounts_receivable.name: Accounts Receivable (A/R)
accounts_receivable._finding: NEGATIVE A/R against 27 open ONACCOUNT sales in Lightspeed. A receivable asset should not be negative; this is Gap B showing up on the balance sheet. Surface it, do not correct it silently.

layaway_liability.name: Revenue Received in Advance - Lightspeed X
layaway_liability._finding: GAP A, CONFIRMED FROM THE QBO SIDE. A liability account named explicitly for Lightspeed X deferred revenue exists — precisely the customer-deposit account layaway needs — and it holds EXACTLY ZERO. This is a balance-sheet account, so unlike an income account a zero here is meaningful rather than a period reset. The container was created and nothing has ever been posted into it, while 3 LAYBY sales sit open in Lightspeed. This is the destination for every layaway adjusting entry Phase 5 proposes.

sales_income_by_line._comment: Income accounts carry current_balance 0 in the Account entity because QBO resets P&L accounts — a zero here is NOT evidence of no activity, unlike account 169 above. Which account each business line posts to must be confirmed against a real closeout before the reconciler relies on it.
